segments.name: Investments
segments.description: An externally managed BDC that invests in debt and equity securities of established lower middle market private businesses in the United States.
segments.evidence: Our current business strategy includes one reporting segment which derives investment income from our portfolio companies.

revenueModel.text: Portfolio companies pay the company interest on its debt investments, generally variable rate loans with floors, plus success fees and returns on its equity investments.
revenueModel.evidence: We seek debt instruments that pay interest monthly or, at a minimum, quarterly, and which may include a yield enhancement such as a success fee or, to a lesser extent, deferred interest provision and are primarily interest only, with all principal and any accrued but unpaid interest due at maturity.
